title: Users
description: Everyone in this tenant's workspace and their current role bindings.

manageDialog.title: Manage roles
manageDialog.description: Grant or revoke {name}'s role bindings. You can only grant or revoke a role at least as privileged as one you already hold: manar-api enforces this on every request regardless of what's offered here.
manageDialog.revokeConfirmDescription: Removes {role} from {name} immediately, in Manar and in the underlying Keycloak realm.
manageDialog.noGrantableRoles: There are no roles left for you to grant this user: either they already hold every role you outrank, or you hold no role that lets you manage role bindings at all.
manageDialog.revokeDisabledHint: You need a role at least as privileged as this one to revoke it.
